diff_tool.description:
Command template for the merge diff tool, e.g. "meld {left} {right}".
Wins over the built-in registry and $EDITOR when set.

fold.description: Fold package directories into single symlinks where possible.

fold_ignore.description: Packages in this list will never be folded (per-package `fold = false`).

ignore.description: Extra glob patterns ignored on top of the built-in stow default list.

on_conflict.description: What to do when a real file already occupies a target path.

source.description:
Stow directory; its direct subdirectories are the packages.
No default — rustow errors out until it is set.

oneOf.description: Prompt on a TTY; abort when not a TTY.
Abort the whole run; never change anything.
Leave the existing target in place.
Delete the target; symlink to the package's version.
Move the target's content into the package; symlink.
